_note: The Foundation home base as DATA — GDD §13, cut to the compact five-room slice of §26.2: operations room, armory/logistics counter, archive terminal, small research station, containment observation corridor. §13.1 asks that preparing for a mission take minutes and not a commute, so this is a screen with tabs rather than a walkable building, and every room is one page. The eight core areas of §13.2 are folded into five: the research station carries the isolation bench that a full site would give the Medical Wing, and the logistics counter carries the Engineering Bay's repair queue. That is not a shortcut, it is the fiction — an underfunded regional facility has one room doing three jobs, and §13.3 says the site begins underfunded.
_effectsNote: Every `effect` key is validated against DEFAULT_EFFECTS in src/sim/progression.js and the file REFUSES to load if it names one no system reads. An upgrade that quietly did nothing would fail §13.3's 'upgrades visibly add capability' without ever failing a test.
standing: Regional Site 19 runs on a regional grant, one vehicle, and whatever the last operation brought back. Nothing here is new and two of the rooms were something else first.

regionalStatus.weather: Overcast, 4C, wind from the north-east. No change expected before the window closes.
regionalStatus.region: Three counties, one duty squad, and a coroner who has stopped asking questions.
regionalStatus.readiness: One vehicle. One command point. Everything you take is everything you have.

rooms.name: Operations room
rooms.purpose: Where an incident becomes an operation. The board, the map table, the regional picture, and the readiness check that says whether the squad can actually go.
rooms.furniture: A map table with a cracked overlay, a wall board, and a radio set that predates the site.
allows: Read the mission board and take the authorised operation
Read the regional and weather picture before committing
Check squad readiness, including who is carrying an injury

upgrades.name: Backup power
upgrades.blurb: A generator and a proper charging bench. Cells go out full instead of go out.
upgrades.visible: The corridor lights stop dropping when the compressor cycles, and every issued item leaves with an extra minute on it.

upgrades.name: Additional vehicle bay
upgrades.blurb: A second vehicle means the manifest stops being a single wager.
upgrades.visible: Two more volume on every cargo manifest, for good.

rooms.name: Armory and logistics counter
rooms.purpose: Loadouts, maintenance, the cargo manifest, and equipment recovery. The counter is also the repair queue, because there is no engineering bay and the same person does both.
rooms.furniture: A roller shutter, a parts bin, and a whiteboard listing what did not come back.
allows: Fit an equipment sidegrade, or refit the standard tool
Requisition new variants against department standing
Read what the last operation failed to recover

upgrades.name: Specialised storage
upgrades.blurb: Climate-controlled racking with sensor ports, and a bonded cage for recovered gear.
upgrades.visible: Two more holding positions in the corridor, and written-off equipment costs a quarter less to reorder.

rooms.name: Archive terminal
rooms.purpose: Case files, mission history, the anomaly codex, and the attribution record. One terminal, one chair, and everything the site has ever filed.
rooms.furniture: A terminal on a desk that was a canteen table.
allows: Read the debrief history, dimension by dimension
Read the case file on anything the site has encountered
Read the attribution and licensing record

upgrades.name: Expanded archives
upgrades.blurb: Proper indexing and a second terminal, so a case file can be cross-read against the last twenty operations.
upgrades.visible: Twenty operations on file instead of twelve, and a tenth more analytical yield from everything you bring back.

upgrades.name: Training and simulation space
upgrades.blurb: A room with a floor plan taped out on it and a procedure rehearsal each week. Departments notice a squad that practises.
upgrades.visible: Every standing gain is worth about a sixth more.

rooms.name: Research station
rooms.purpose: Sample analysis, research projects, and the isolation bench the site uses to treat exposure because there is no medical wing.
rooms.furniture: A fume hood, a sample fridge, and one isolation bed behind a curtain.
allows: Spend research data on prototypes and analytical unlocks
Read what the site knows about an anomaly, and what it would take to know more
Treat an injured operative, or decide not to and field them anyway

upgrades.name: Better medical isolation
upgrades.blurb: A second bed, a real airlock, and a supply cupboard that is not shared with the sample fridge.
upgrades.visible: Two operatives can be treated in the same rotation, and a course costs less than half again.

rooms.name: Containment observation corridor
rooms.purpose: A short run of cells and monitor feeds. Whatever the site is holding is held here, and the corridor's job is to record what holding it costs.
rooms.furniture: Three cells, a monitor bank with one dead channel, and a clipboard nobody has replaced with a tablet.
allows: Read the operational history of everything in custody
Read the maintenance record and what the next check is due
See which holding positions are free before committing to an operation

upgrades.name: Stronger perimeter monitoring
upgrades.blurb: Sensors on the corridor and the fence line, reporting continuously instead of when somebody walks past.
upgrades.visible: Checks fall due two operations further apart, and the regional grant goes up because the auditors can see the logs.

operations.name: Cold storage, level 2
operations.distance: Forty minutes out. Sub-level, no surface exposure.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of the anomaly on level 2 and transfer it to the stair head.
conditions: Mains down six days. Two circuits, both dead.
One surviving crew member waiting at the stair head.
Plant log reports the chiller ran eleven days against a four-hour duty cycle.

operations.name: Cold storage, aisle B
operations.distance: The same floor as the last one. You already know the way.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of the figure reported in aisle B and transfer it to the stair head.
optional: Preserve a dust sample from the ring
conditions: Repeat sighting, four calls in one shift, nothing found on four walks.
The supervisor watched it on camera instead and it stayed put for six hours.
Fourteen unexplained brownouts on the storage circuit, none over nine seconds.
operations._note: The SAME MAP as op-cold-storage-2 and a completely different operation — GDD 15.2's epistemic and operational variation. The board is the one place a player sees that the building is a constant and the incident is the variable.

operations.name: Ashlar House, ninth floor
operations.distance: Two hours out, then nine floors on foot. The lift is out and the stair is the only way anything leaves.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of the anomaly on the ninth floor and transfer it to the east landing.
optional: Recover the contractor day book intact
conditions: Condemned crosswall block, decanted eleven months, stripped back to the frame.
Both circuits are on the contractor temporaries. Nothing is locked; everything is stuck open.
The drained district-heating gallery runs the full width of the floor behind the store rooms.
operations._note: THE SAME ANOMALY as op-cold-storage-2, on different geometry — the mirror of what the aisle B operation does. GDD 15.2 varies the incident against a constant building; this varies the building against a constant incident, and a squad that arrives with the cold store playbook has brought the right tools in the wrong quantity to the wrong end of a very long walk.

operations.name: Cold storage, the stocktake
operations.distance: The same forty minutes, the same stair, the third time.
operations.mandate: Recover the discrepancy in full, verify the count against the stocktake, and transfer it to the stair head.
optional: Log nothing into the case that does not belong there
Read the second clerk's sheet before committing to a count
conditions: Two independent stocktakes returned the same wrong number.
Nothing on this floor has been reported as moving, and nobody has been hurt.
The clerk who ran the second count is at the stair head and has her sheet.
operations._note: THE THIRD FAMILY (GDD 26.2: distributed-object recovery and verification) and the third operation on this one floor. Nothing hunts you here, there is no fence, and the failure state is arithmetic. A squad that has done the other two walks in knowing where the breakers are and which aisle is long, and none of that is the answer — familiarity is the trap.

operations.name: Blackthorn Reserve, north plantation
operations.distance: Ninety minutes, then a forest track. Two ways across the drainage channel and one of them is gated.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of whatever is in the north plantation and transfer it to the vehicles.
optional: Take the contractor's statement before deploying
conditions: Mains down across the reserve. One generator, not running since the withdrawal.
A tree-safety crew withdrew; one of them walked out on his hands and knees.
The duty ranger spent a further night in the station with everything switched off and reported nothing at all.
operations._note: THE SLICE'S FOREST MAP AND ITS AUDITORY FAMILY, which belong together. Blackthorn has no lanes — 41.5% of it has all twenty-four escape rays open and none of it is fenced bare — so it cannot host a fence incident honestly, and the caller does not want one. It is restrained by SILENCE, which is available everywhere and weighs nothing. A squad that arrives with the draught playbook deploys four humming objects and builds itself a beacon.

operations.name: Coldharbour cold storage, level 2
operations.distance: Forty minutes. The same goods lift, the same stair, the same floor you have been on three times.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of whatever is at the north end of the west run and transfer it to the stair head.
conditions: One fatality on the floor since Tuesday. He was warm when they found him on the Wednesday.
One powered object on this level in eleven weeks, and it failed at 06:14 on Tuesday morning.
The fixed camera at the head of the west run has been turned to the wall and taped over from the aisle side. Nobody has claimed it.
operations._note: THE FOURTH OPERATION ON THIS FLOOR, and the one that punishes knowing it. A squad arrives with three operations' worth of correct knowledge about cold storage level 2 and every piece of it is aimed at the wrong thing: nothing here is fenced by anything ever, a camera anywhere near the case makes the operation stutter, and restoring the mains only makes the floor bright enough to look at things by — which is the failure mode. The one habit that survives is the one nobody thinks of as a habit: get the case powered before anything else happens.

operations.name: Ashlar House, Flat 5
operations.distance: The same two hours and the same nine floors. You already know which stair.
operations.mandate: Establish custody of whatever is in Flat 5 and transfer it to the east landing.
optional: Recover the fitter's helmet camera intact
conditions: Five flats stripped out, the sixth abandoned after three half days.
One man off with a cold burn and a fractured wrist; the other walked out and will not go back.
The watchman has walked the ninth in the dark for four months and reports no trouble.
operations._note: THE SECOND OPERATION ON THE NINTH FLOOR, and the one that inverts what the first taught. The gallery draught is a journey and a fence; this never leaves one flat and there is nothing to build. Ashlar's thirty-eight plasterboard walls were useless against the draught and are the answer here: they stop a sightline and nothing else, so a wall on this floor is privacy rather than protection. A squad that has done aisle B will deploy a camera on it out of habit and hold it rigid for that camera's whole battery.

_boardNote: Seven operations, and every one of them is playable to custody — the board does not pad itself with contracts that do not exist. §18.1 does not allow the UI to lie about what is available, so a greyed-out entry would be a promise this build cannot keep. Three buildings carry seven incidents: cold storage level 2 alone has four, and the ninth floor of Ashlar has two. That is the whole of §15.2 in one column — the building is a variable and the incident is a variable, and they vary independently — and by the fourth trip down the same stair the point is no longer that the map is reused. It is that a squad arrives carrying three operations' worth of correct knowledge about that floor and has to work out which of it still applies.

containmentWing.framing: Entries record where it came from, what holding it costs, and what it has done since. They do not rank captures, do not count them as a score, and do not describe anything held here as a prize. An object in a cell is an ongoing operational commitment, not a result.
maintenanceNotes: Scheduled check. Cell log reviewed against the sensor bus; no discrepancy recorded.
Interior temperature drifted 0.4C over the interval. Within tolerance, logged, watched.
Monitor channel two reported a two-second dropout. Cause not established. Cell inspected and re-sealed.
Consumable draw above forecast for the interval. Requisition notified.

cells.label: Cell 1
cells.holding: Insulated, heated, sensor ports on the corridor bus. The only position rated for a thermal negative.

cells.label: Cell 2
cells.holding: General holding. Sealed door, one camera, no environmental control.

cells.label: Cell 3
cells.holding: Locker-scale. Objects and samples, not organisms. The extract fan has been on the list since March.

dossiers._designationNote: A provisional internal designation, not an SCP number. GDD §25.3 holds that a final designation is assigned only after the licensing record exists, and content/anomalies/graybox-draught.json carries `licensingRecordId: null`. Nothing in this build should print a number it has not earned the right to print.
dossiers.classFraming: A thermal negative that moves toward heat and cannot cross a sustained gradient above 40C. Not hostile in any sense the site can evidence; it is cold, and people are warm.
dossiers.holding: escort at 39C in a heated transit case, corridor cleared, two operatives
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs a heated cell on continuous draw and a fortnightly gradient check. It has never tested the seal. It has never had to.

insights.text: Thermal is the only reliable observation channel. It records faithfully in that band and not at all in the visible one, so a camera that sees nothing is not evidence of absence.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: The gradient figure is 40C, sustained and continuous. A contour with a gap in it is not a fence, and the aisles on level 2 are 4.2m across.
insights.grants: The figure appears on the briefing instead of being inferred in the field.

insights.text: It goes to the warmest thing it can reach. A transit case held one degree under the threshold out-competes an operative; a tripod set down too near the case takes the case over the threshold and the lure stops working.
insights.grants: The archive files this as a procedure note rather than a hard-won field lesson.

dossiers.classFraming: Stationary under observation and fast without it. It reads at ambient in every band the site can instrument, so the only channel that records it is a person or a camera looking at it, and the record ends the moment the looking does.
dossiers.holding: two channels of continuous coverage on independent supplies, corridor cleared, three operatives
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs two camera channels that must never both be down, and the cell's own draw is what its capability reaches for. The wing runs the corridor bus off the second supply for this reason and not for redundancy.

insights.text: It reads at ambient on thermal, in every state, at every distance. An imager pointed at it shows the aisle. The imager is not the wrong instrument for this floor; there is no right one.
insights.grants: The briefing stops listing the imager as a detection asset for this incident.

insights.text: Coverage is a resource the squad also needs for carrying, placing, powering and sealing. A camera holds it exactly as well as a person does and does not need to stand there, which is the whole procedure and the reason the cameras are the first thing its capability browns out.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: A moment of lost coverage does not release it. A second and a half does. The gap between those two figures is the entire margin a handover has, and it does not widen with practice.
insights.grants: The figure appears on the briefing instead of being learned at the cost of a contact.

dossiers.classFraming: A discrepancy rather than an object: five items in a set of eleven that are indistinguishable from the other six by eye, by weight and by every hand instrument the site issues. Nothing about it moves and nobody has been hurt by it.
dossiers.holding: the set held complete in one locker, count verified against the sheet at every check
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs nothing but an accurate count, and that is the expensive part. A check that reports eleven without recounting is not a check, and the wing has been asked twice to explain why the interval is per-item.

insights.text: Each one is a four-degree sink. Three together read nearly eight degrees below ambient and are obvious from a doorway; one on its own reads under four and has to be stood over. The instrument the squad brought to fence a draught is the instrument that finds these, used the other way round.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: The case takes a mundane one silently and the count does not move. Nothing announces the mistake. Noticing that the number stayed still is the whole verification, and a squad that seals on a number it did not watch change has sealed on a guess.
insights.grants: The archive files this as a procedure note rather than a debrief finding.

insights.text: The total is on the stocktake sheet in the office and has never been on the HUD. Sealing on three of five is a legal, survivable, wrong answer that the operation does not report until the debrief.
insights.grants: The briefing names where the sheet is.

dossiers.classFraming: It moves toward sound and stops in silence. Heat does not stop it and walls do, which makes a building the only fence available and makes every powered object the site owns a lure.
dossiers.holding: escort with all carried equipment off, cell on the isolated corridor spur, two operatives
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs the wing's extract fans on the north corridor, which have been switched to the manual schedule since the transfer. The consumable draw is trivial and the noise budget is not.

insights.text: A heater carries twenty-two metres, a floodlight ballast eleven, a power pack seven. On a cold-store floor those numbers are the fence and the bait. Here every one of them is a beacon, and a squad running the draught playbook has built a perfect lure around itself and switched it on.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: Two sources of comparable level at comparable range do not make a stronger lure. They make an unresolvable one, and it stops in the wrong place, which looks exactly like the rule failing and is the rule working.
insights.grants: The archive files this as a procedure note rather than a field lesson paid for with a contact.

insights.text: At two metres: 29.6 dB standing still, 35.1 crouch-walking, 48.0 walking, against a 46 dB threshold. Crouch stops being a way to be shorter and becomes the approach.
insights.grants: The figures appear on the briefing instead of being found by walking at it once.

dossiers.classFraming: It does not move and it does not choose. Anything warm that comes within a metre and a half of it is taken, and it will not be observed while it is holding something. The site records one fatality and one serious burn, neither of them the result of being approached deliberately.
dossiers.holding: sealed transit case on continuous supply, no camera on the cell interior, two operatives
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs a case that is never allowed to go flat and a cell whose interior channel stays off. The monitor bus records the door and the corridor and nothing else, which is a documented exception and not an outage.

insights.text: It reads at ambient on every instrument in the manifest, in every state, from every distance. What the imager is for on this floor is the wake it leaves: a band of thawed and refrozen floor, and boot prints in it that are not the squad's.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: A camera left pointing near the case does not stall the operation, it makes it stutter: take, let go, take, on a three-and-a-half second cycle, with the drain running through half of it. The seal is genuinely available in the other half. The case's twelve minutes come out at about five.
insights.grants: The archive files this as a procedure note rather than a debrief arithmetic problem.

insights.text: Three operations' worth of correct knowledge about this floor is aimed at the wrong thing. The only habit that survives is the one nobody thinks of as a habit: get the case out of cargo and get it powered before anything else happens.
insights.grants: The briefing carries the sequence rather than the squad reconstructing it.

dossiers.classFraming: Attention sets it rigid and inattention slackens it. Being watched is not a restraint here, it is the condition under which nothing can be done: the opposite of SW-11, on the same quantity, and the wing has asked twice that the two not be filed together.
dossiers.holding: sealed case, cell interior channel off, door channel only, two operatives
dossiers.operationalCost: Holding it costs the same interior channel CH-02 costs, for the opposite reason: a camera on this one holds it rigid indefinitely and there is then no way to open the cell. The extract fan is on the list.

insights.text: Setting is instantaneous and from any state. Slackening takes five continuous seconds of nobody and no camera holding it in view. An operative who glances round to check where the case is has spent five seconds they have to buy again.
insights.grants: A line on the operation card before the squad deploys.

insights.text: A sightline is stopped by eleven millimetres of plasterboard exactly as completely as by a concrete crosswall. On the ninth floor of Ashlar that means a wall which stops nothing at all can hide you from this, and hiding is the entire containment.
insights.grants: The archive files the standing position rather than the squad finding it by being seen.

insights.text: The five-second figure sits inside the seven-second contact cooldown, so an operative who takes station correctly eats exactly one contact and not two. A squad that does not know the figure is five will turn back round at three and buy nothing.
insights.grants: Both figures appear on the briefing.

_insightNote: Insights grant CONTEXT ONLY — a line the briefing did not previously carry. None of them changes a number the anomaly obeys, because GDD §12.1 says progression must not turn horror into immunity. A squad that has read all three still has to build the fence.
